title: AIHWBench: vendor-neutral local AI hardware benchmarks
description: Measured benchmarks of local AI runtimes on consumer and edge hardware, with a comparison-safety classifier that states when two results cannot honestly be compared. Every published result carries the environment it was measured in, the machine load at the time, and a trust state.
notes: The DOI covers a dataset snapshot, not the tool. Snapshots are produced by `aihwbench snapshot`, which records the result set and its hashes, so a citation resolves to an exact set of measurements rather than to whatever the repository holds today.
